notes: a clarification of the Saduq's routes to Ali b. Ri'ab: the opening «ما كان فيه عن علي بن رئاب» governs each item, and the target is written out only at the end
«أبي» is the Saduq's father, named only by relation (rule 7)
the second and third items end at the last name the text writes; the target is not repeated there, so no link is added
